description: Add a new homepage section with an animated flowchart visualizing the club equipment ordering workflow using xyflow

userStories.title: Create base WorkflowSection component structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a new section component that will house the interactive flowchart.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /src/components/Workflow/Workflow.tsx component
Add section with consistent styling (padding, max-width) matching other homepage sections
Include section header with title and subtitle from dictionary
Add dictionary entries for workflow.title, workflow.subtitle in all three language files (da.json, en.json, de.json)
Title should be something like 'Fra bestilling til levering' (From order to delivery)
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Install and configure xyflow
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the xyflow library installed and configured for the workflow visualization.
acceptanceCriteria: Install @xyflow/react package via npm
Verify package installs without peer dependency conflicts
Create basic React Flow canvas inside Workflow component
Configure flow with fitView and disabled interactions (panOnDrag: false, zoomOnScroll: false, nodesDraggable: false, zoomOnPinch: false, preventScrolling: false)
Use dynamic import if needed to avoid SSR issues with Next.js
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Design workflow nodes with B2B Sport styling
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want the flowchart nodes to match the website's visual design language.
acceptanceCriteria: Create custom node component in /src/components/Workflow/WorkflowNode.tsx
Style nodes with B2B Sport colors (cream, coral, forest palette)
Each node has: Lucide icon, title text
Nodes use rounded corners (rounded-xl), subtle shadows consistent with site design
Use Lucide icons matching rest of site
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement workflow process steps
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see the typical equipment ordering workflow visualized as connected steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Define 6 workflow nodes: 1) Opret klub (UserPlus icon), 2) Se aftalepriser (Tag icon), 3) Saml bestilling (ShoppingCart icon), 4) Godkend internt (CheckCircle icon), 5) Bekræft ordre (Send icon), 6) Spor levering (Truck icon)
Add dictionary entries for each node title in all three language files
Nodes arranged in horizontal flow on desktop
Edges/connections between nodes styled with coral color
Use animated edges (animated: true) for visual interest
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Run npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3000/da and confirm workflow section shows 6 connected nodes

userStories.title: Add Workflow section to homepage
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see the workflow section on the homepage in a logical position.
acceptanceCriteria: Import and add Workflow component to homepage (/src/app/[locale]/page.tsx)
Position after ValueProposition section, before SportsGrid
Section has appropriate spacing/margin relative to adjacent sections
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Run npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:3000/da and confirm workflow section appears between ValueProposition and SportsGrid

userStories.title: Ensure responsive behavior
userStories.description: As a mobile visitor, I want the workflow to display appropriately on smaller screens.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (< 768px): nodes stack vertically or use simplified 2-column grid view
Flow container has appropriate height on all screen sizes
No horizontal scroll caused by flow on mobile
Consider hiding React Flow on mobile and showing a simple styled list instead
npm run typecheck passes
Visual verification: Run npm run dev, open http://localhost:3000/da in mobile viewport (375px width) and confirm workflow section is readable and usable
